newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Equitorial rejects AMP takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Equitorial rejects AMP takeover bid.

text.p: The board of Equatorial Mining Ltd on Thursday advised shareholders not to accept a takeover offer by Quay Mining Pty Ltd, part of The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP), following consideration of an independent report.
Quay is offering 25 cents a share for the junior miner.
However, the board said an independent report by investment bank Grant Samuel had assessed the value of the shares in the range of 36 cents to 47 cents per share.
"This is between 44 percent and 88 percent more than AMP's current offer," the Equatorial board said.
"Grant Samuel has concluded that the offer by AMP is neither fair nor reasonable," it said.
"In addition, the independent directors of Equatorial believe that the company has both current and potential value in excess of the Grant Samuel range," it said.
"Accordingly, the independent directors have unanimously recommended that shareholders do not accept AMP's offer by simply taking no action in respect of the offer," it said.
The AMP holds about 35 percent of Equatorial, which is involved in the El Tesoro copper project in Chile. The project is expected to go into production in 1998.
Equatorial shares were trading at 30 cents at midday on Thursdsay on the Australian Stock Exchange.
At that price, the company is valued at about A$95 million.
